decision_conditions: The proposed roof light which exceeds the ridge of the roof is unacceptable, resulting in a form of development that would respond negatively to the surrounding properties, disturbing the existing rhythm of the street and causing harm to the roofscape character particularly when viewed in in context with the adjoining properties and relevant terrace parade. This is contrary to Policy 53 of the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2025).

The proposed infill extension by reason of its excessive depth and height would have a detrimental impact on the residential amenity of the occupiers at No. 35 Hartley Road that would result in a serious loss of outlook, light and would create an increased sense of enclosure, contrary to Policy 57 of the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2025).

Notwithstanding the first two points of refusal, insufficient detail has been provided with respect to the terrace balustrading and fixings. Therefore, the application cannot be fully considered in terms of the visual impact of the scheme on the host property and neighbouring properties. This is contrary to Policy 53 of the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2025).
description:
(1) Construction of a dormer roof extension to main rear
roof, with extension above two storey rear projection including the
creation of a terrace. Together with the installation of two roof
lights to the front roof slope. (2) Demolition of existing rear projections and
construction of a single storey rear and infill extension(s).
(3) Installation of a rear canopy and veranda. (4) Reinstatement of
pitched roof at first floor principal elevation.
